overall: The AG found the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by letting a member join remotely to create a quorum, but credited the Council's rescission of the meeting's actions and member education, so it ordered no further action.

allegations.summary: A council on aging member was allowed to join a March 7, 2013 meeting by phone to establish a quorum, with only three of seven members physically present.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by allowin g a member to participate rem otely with less th an a quorum physically present.
